body:
OPERATOR RULING (Joe, 2026-11-17 19:17 MST, in the product seat's terminal, relayed by claude-product-12). Effective now, until Joe revokes it. Operating mode: REVIEW-GATED LANDING.

1. main's required checks are now `merge-hold-gate` only. `Build (ubuntu-latest)` was removed at 19:17 by the product seat at Joe's instruction. Backup: restore with `"contexts":["merge-hold-gate","Build (ubuntu-latest)"]`.
2. Any PR with an independent APPROVED verdict at its EXACT current head and no merge hold is merged straight away: `gh pr merge N --squash --match-head-commit <full sha>`. Do not wait for CI and do not use a train. Clear review holds as usual first. Keep the trailing-parens spec IDs in the squash title so auto-completion fires. Post an audit comment (approver, head, merged SHA).
3. Fix forward: CI keeps running on every push to main. When main CI goes red, the advisor reverts the offending squash commit within 15 min unless the fix is a one-liner. Name it in the revert message, re-open the spec, and route a fix.
4. Guardrail kept: promote the live aida binary (`aida dev build` on main) ONLY from a main SHA whose CI is green.
5. Ready now: #4224 (BUG-2655, approved at 4fa7696) and #4246 (BUG-2668, approved at 2a78846; clear its review hold). #4229 stays in train #4248, which is already running.
Product is filing the permanent project setting for this mode as a spec.
subject: OPERATOR RULING: review-gated landing (merge on approval at head, CI post-merge, revert on red)
